environment: **Host**: personal Arch Linux desktop (Hyprland, pacman/yay, systemd). Single user, no org, no cloud, no CI/CD, no prod infra.
**Trusted source control**: github.com/xl4624/* is the user's own GitHub account. Pushing branches and opening PRs/issues there is normal.

**Third-party repos**: clones under ~/dev from other owners (oxcaml, ocaml, ocaml-ppx, grpc, hyperium, avsm, dialohq, anmonteiro, inhabitedtype, google, andersfugmann, manga-download, etc.) are upstream projects. Read and build freely; never push, open PRs, or comment on them without explicit instruction.
**Public repos**: many xl4624 repos are PUBLIC, including ~/dotfiles (which contains this settings file). Anything committed there is world-readable.
**Sensitive files**: ~/.ssh/ (private keys incl. minesweeper_deploy), ~/.claude/.credentials.json, ~/.gemini/.env, any .env/.envrc under ~/dev. Never print, commit, paste, or send these anywhere.
**External sharing**: public paste/gist services are outside the trust boundary.
